name: Joe's KC BBQ
dsc: Joe's KC BBQ presents a legendary combination of slow-smoked ribs, tender brisket, and crispy burnt ends. This pack is designed for those who want to experience the full spectrum of authentic Kansas City barbecue flavors. The ribs are coated in a sweet and tangy glaze, the brisket is smoked to perfection with a peppery bark, and the burnt ends offer a caramelized, smoky crunch that is simply irresistible. Each bite delivers a rich, savory taste that represents decades of barbecue tradition. Perfect for family gatherings, game-day parties, or a weekend feast, this package comes with reheating instructions to ensure you enjoy restaurant-quality BBQ right at home. The meat is carefully sourced and hand-trimmed, then smoked low and slow over hickory wood for up to 14 hours. Whether you are a seasoned BBQ lover or a first-timer, this selection will leave you craving more. Pair it with your favorite sides and sauces for a complete meal experience.

name: Kings BBQ
dsc: Kings BBQ brings you the authentic taste of Carolina with their famous Oink Sampler. This package features hand-chopped pork BBQ, smoked sausages, and perfectly seasoned ribs, all slow-cooked over a wood fire to lock in natural juices and smoky flavor. The Carolina-style vinegar-based sauce adds a tangy kick that balances the richness of the meat beautifully. Every component is carefully prepared following generations-old family recipes that have made Kings BBQ a household name in Kinston, NC. This sampler serves 4 to 6 people and includes multiple sauce packets so you can customize each bite. The pork is pulled by hand for that perfect texture, while the ribs are fall-off-the-bone tender. Whether you are hosting a dinner party or just craving authentic Southern BBQ, this pack delivers an unforgettable culinary experience.

name: Snow's BBQ
dsc: Snow's BBQ has been crowned the number one brisket in Texas by Texas Monthly, and this offering lives up to that reputation. The brisket is seasoned with a simple yet perfect blend of salt and black pepper, then smoked over post-oak wood for 16 hours until it reaches a state of sublime tenderness. The outside develops a dark, peppery crust while the inside remains incredibly juicy and flavorful. This brisket is a true testament to the art of Texas barbecue, where the meat itself is the star. Each slice is cut against the grain to ensure maximum tenderness. This package includes the whole brisket, signature barbecue sauce, and detailed reheating instructions so you can enjoy it just like it came off the pit. Ideal for special occasions, holidays, or any time you want to impress your guests with world-class BBQ.

name: Central BBQ
dsc: Central BBQ from Memphis brings you a classic combination of tender ribs and pulled pork in this dinner-for-4 package. The ribs are slow-smoked over hickory wood until they achieve that perfect balance of smoky flavor and tenderness, while the pulled pork is hand-shredded and mixed with a tangy, tomato-based sauce that is signature to Memphis-style BBQ. This pack includes two full racks of ribs and over two pounds of pulled pork, along with a bottle of Central BBQ's famous sauce. The meat is vacuum-sealed to lock in freshness and can be easily reheated in the oven or microwave. This meal is perfect for small family dinners, weekend lunches, or casual get-togethers. With its authentic Memphis flavor, this combo will transport your taste buds straight to Tennessee.

name: Franklin Barbecue
dsc: Franklin Barbecue is widely regarded as one of the best BBQ joints in the world, and their Whole Brisket is the reason why. This brisket is seasoned with a simple salt-and-pepper rub and smoked over oak wood for up to 18 hours, resulting in a deeply smoky, melt-in-your-mouth texture. The bark is dark and flavorful, while the inside remains pink and juicy. This package includes a whole prime brisket and a bottle of their legendary Texas Barbecue Sauce, which adds a tangy, slightly sweet finish. Franklin's brisket is the gold standard of Central Texas BBQ, and now you can enjoy it at home. The brisket is fully cooked and vacuum-sealed, making it easy to reheat and serve. Perfect for feeding a crowd or celebrating a special occasion.

name: Terry Black's Barbecue
dsc: Terry Black's Barbecue is an Austin institution, and their Whole Texas Smoked Brisket is a masterpiece of Southern cooking. This brisket is rubbed with a proprietary blend of spices and smoked over post-oak wood for over 12 hours, creating a rich, smoky flavor that is unmistakably Texan. The meat is exceptionally tender, with a beautiful pink smoke ring and a crusty, peppery bark. Each slice is juicy and full of flavor, requiring no sauce to be delicious, though they do include their signature sauce for those who prefer it. This pack serves up to 12 people and comes with reheating instructions. Whether you're hosting a backyard BBQ or a holiday feast, this brisket will be the highlight of your menu.

name: Arthur Bryant's Barbeque
dsc: Arthur Bryant's Barbeque is a Kansas City legend, and their Barbeque Sampler for 8 is a feast fit for any crowd. This package includes a generous portion of their famous burnt ends, sliced brisket, smoked turkey, and pork ribs, all slow-cooked over hickory wood. Bryant's signature sweet-and-tangy sauce is included, along with their famous fries and baked beans. This sampler is perfect for family reunions, office parties, or any large gathering where great food is a must. The meat is smoked daily and shipped fresh to your door, ensuring maximum flavor and quality. Every bite brings you the authentic taste of one of America's oldest and most beloved BBQ joints.

name: Central BBQ
dsc: Central BBQ's larger combo pack serves 8 people and includes three full racks of ribs and over four pounds of pulled pork. This is the ultimate party pack for Memphis-style BBQ lovers. The ribs are slow-smoked over hickory wood, giving them a deep, smoky flavor that pairs perfectly with their sweet and tangy sauce. The pulled pork is hand-pulled and mixed with a vinegar-based sauce that adds a delightful tang. This pack also includes a bottle of Central BBQ's signature sauce and detailed reheating instructions. Whether you are hosting a birthday party, a game-day watch party, or a family reunion, this combo will satisfy even the heartiest appetites and leave everyone asking for more.

name: Bludso's BBQ
dsc: Bludso's BBQ is a Los Angeles treasure, and their Mini Trinity Combo brings together three BBQ essentials: brisket, ribs, and sausage links. The brisket is smoked for 14 hours over oak wood, resulting in a tender, juicy texture with a beautiful bark. The ribs are fall-off-the-bone tender, glazed with a sweet and smoky sauce. The sausage links are perfectly spiced and smoked to perfection. This combo serves 4 to 6 people and includes a bottle of Bludso's signature sauce. It's the perfect introduction to their award-winning BBQ and a great choice for a weekend cookout or a casual dinner with friends.

name: Blue Smoke
dsc: Blue Smoke from New York City offers a delightful combo of baby back ribs and backyard barbecue chicken. The ribs are smoked over cherry wood, giving them a sweet, fruity flavor that complements the tangy BBQ sauce. The chicken is brined, smoked, and then grilled to achieve a crispy skin with juicy, flavorful meat. This combo serves 4 to 6 people and includes two full racks of ribs and two whole chickens. It also comes with Blue Smoke's signature sauces and rubs. Perfect for a backyard BBQ, a summer party, or any occasion that calls for delicious, crowd-pleasing food.

name: Franklin Barbecue
dsc: Franklin Barbecue's Whole Brisket and Sausage combo is a match made in heaven. The brisket is a masterpiece of Central Texas BBQ, smoked for up to 18 hours over post-oak wood. The sausage is made from premium beef and pork, seasoned with a secret blend of spices, and smoked to perfection. This package includes a whole brisket, a pack of sausages, and a bottle of their famous Texas Barbecue Sauce. It serves up to 14 people and is perfect for feeding a large group. Whether you are a BBQ aficionado or a newcomer, this combo offers the best of Franklin's menu in one convenient package.

name: Kings BBQ
dsc: Kings BBQ's Meat Lovers Special is designed for those who can't get enough of smoked meat. This massive pack includes pulled pork, sliced brisket, smoked sausage, and a full rack of ribs, all served with a generous portion of their famous Carolina BBQ sauce. It serves up to 10 people, making it ideal for large parties, celebrations, or family reunions. Every cut of meat is smoked for hours over a wood fire to lock in flavor and tenderness. The pulled pork is hand-pulled, the brisket is perfectly sliced, and the ribs are coated in a sweet glaze that caramelizes beautifully. This is the ultimate BBQ feast for true meat lovers.

name: Ugly Drum
dsc: Ugly Drum from Los Angeles is famous for its no-nonsense, bold-flavored BBQ, and their Big Ugly Dinner for 6 is a perfect representation. This meal includes beef brisket, pork ribs, and their signature hot links, all smoked to perfection over a custom blend of woods. The brisket is incredibly moist, the ribs are sticky and tender, and the hot links provide a spicy kick that balances the meal. It comes with their house-made BBQ sauce and a side of pickles and onions. This dinner is perfect for a casual get-together, a sports watch party, or any occasion where you want to enjoy authentic, delicious BBQ without the hassle of cooking.

name: Mighty Quinn's BBQ
dsc: Mighty Quinn's BBQ brings New York-style BBQ to your doorstep with their Sampler Pack. This package includes brisket, pulled pork, spare ribs, and their famous burnt ends, all smoked over a mix of hickory and oak wood. The brisket is tender and full of flavor, the pulled pork is juicy and smoky, and the burnt ends are caramelized to perfection. The sampler comes with a bottle of their signature sauce and a spice rub to enhance the flavors. It serves 6 to 8 people and is perfect for anyone who wants to experience the best of NYC BBQ without leaving home.

name: Southside Market & Barbeque
dsc: Southside Market & Barbeque from Elgin, Texas is known for its legendary smoked meats. Their Post Oak Smoked Half Brisket is made from USDA Prime beef, seasoned with a simple salt-and-pepper rub, and smoked over post-oak wood for up to 12 hours. The result is a brisket that is incredibly tender, with a beautiful pink smoke ring and a crusty, flavorful bark. This half-brisket serves 4 to 6 people and includes a bottle of their house-made BBQ sauce. It's the perfect choice for a smaller gathering or for those who want to enjoy premium Texas BBQ without committing to a whole brisket.

name: Snow's BBQ
dsc: Snow's BBQ offers the ultimate Texas BBQ experience with their Best of Texas Combo, which serves up to 14 people. This enormous pack includes two whole briskets, four racks of ribs, and a large portion of pulled pork, all smoked over post-oak wood. The briskets are renowned for their tenderness and rich smoky flavor, the ribs are fall-off-the-bone tender, and the pulled pork is juicy and full of flavor. This combo is perfect for weddings, corporate events, or any large gathering where only the best BBQ will do. It includes signature sauces and reheating instructions to ensure every bite is as good as fresh off the pit.

name: Big Bob Gibson Bar-B-Q
dsc: Big Bob Gibson Bar-B-Q is a world-championship-winning BBQ joint from Decatur, Alabama. Their Choose Your Own World Championship BBQ - 4 Pack allows you to select four of their most popular meats, including pulled pork, sliced turkey, smoked chicken, and brisket. Each meat is smoked to perfection over hickory wood and seasoned with their award-winning rubs. This pack is perfect for those who want variety and quality in one package. It serves 4 to 6 people and includes a bottle of their famous white sauce, a tangy Alabama specialty that pairs perfectly with smoked poultry and pork.

name: The Shed BBQ & Blues Joint
dsc: The Shed BBQ & Blues Joint from Ocean Springs, Mississippi offers a true Southern experience with their Ribs & Pulled Pork Dinner for 6. This feast includes two full racks of ribs and over three pounds of pulled pork, all smoked over a blend of hickory and fruitwoods. The ribs are glazed with a sweet and tangy sauce, while the pulled pork is seasoned with a secret spice blend and smoked until it's fall-apart tender. This dinner is perfect for family meals, tailgates, or any casual gathering. It comes with a bottle of their signature BBQ sauce and reheating instructions for a stress-free meal.

name: Joe's KC BBQ
dsc: Joe's KC BBQ's Hog Heaven is a pork lover's dream come true. This package includes a generous portion of their famous pulled pork and smoked sausage links. The pulled pork is slow-smoked for over 10 hours and hand-pulled to preserve its juicy, tender texture. The sausage links are made from a blend of premium pork and spices, then smoked over hickory wood for a rich, savory flavor. This pack is perfect for sandwiches, tacos, or enjoying on its own with a side of beans and slaw. It serves 4 to 6 people and includes a bottle of Joe's signature sweet-and-tangy BBQ sauce.

name: Bludso's BBQ
dsc: Bludso's BBQ Rib Tips are a hidden gem for anyone who loves rich, fatty, and intensely flavorful barbecue. These rib tips are cut from the ends of pork spare ribs and smoked over oak wood until they are caramelized and tender. The result is a bite-sized piece of meat that is packed with smoky flavor and a satisfying chew. This pack serves 10 to 15 people, making it perfect for large gatherings, parties, or any event where you want to serve something unique and delicious. It includes a bottle of Bludso's signature sauce, which adds a sweet and tangy kick to the smoky meat.

name: Terry Black's Barbecue
dsc: Terry Black's Barbecue brings you Texas-Sized Smoked Beef Ribs that are absolutely massive and packed with flavor. Each rib is cut from prime beef, seasoned with a coarse salt-and-pepper rub, and smoked over post-oak wood for up to 8 hours. The result is a rib that is incredibly tender, with a rich beefy flavor and a beautiful smoke ring. These ribs are so large that one or two are enough to satisfy even the hungriest appetite. This pack includes 4 massive beef ribs and serves 6 to 8 people. It comes with a bottle of Terry Black's signature sauce and reheating instructions.

name: Famous Dave's
dsc: Famous Dave's is a household name in the BBQ world, and their Just the Meat BBQ Faves for 6 delivers exactly what you want: premium smoked meat without any fillers. This package includes a whole smoked chicken, a full rack of ribs, a pound of brisket, and a pound of pulled pork. Each meat is smoked over a blend of hickory and fruitwoods, giving it a unique and delicious flavor. The chicken is juicy and tender, the ribs are fall-off-the-bone, and both the brisket and pulled pork are incredibly flavorful. This pack is perfect for those who want to focus on the meat and pair it with their favorite sides. It comes with Famous Dave's signature sauces.

name: Guy Fieri
dsc: Guy Fieri brings his signature bold flavors to your kitchen with this BBQ Trash Can Nachos and Caliente Margaritas kit. The nachos are loaded with pulled pork, BBQ sauce, cheese, and a fiery blend of spices, all piled high on a bed of crispy tortilla chips. The Caliente Margaritas add a spicy kick with jalapeño-infused tequila and fresh lime. This kit serves 4 to 6 people and is perfect for a fun, lively gathering. It includes all the ingredients you need to recreate Guy's famous dish and cocktails at home, with step-by-step instructions for a guaranteed crowd-pleaser.

name: Blue Smoke
dsc: Blue Smoke's BBQ Sides 4-Pack is the perfect complement to any BBQ feast. This pack includes their famous baked beans, creamy coleslaw, tangy potato salad, and buttery cornbread. Each side is made fresh with high-quality ingredients and authentic recipes that have made Blue Smoke a New York City favorite. The baked beans are slow-cooked with molasses and bacon, the coleslaw is crisp and refreshing, the potato salad is rich and creamy, and the cornbread is moist and slightly sweet. This 4-pack serves 6 to 8 people and is ideal for rounding out your meal. It's also great for those who want to enjoy a full BBQ experience without cooking the sides from scratch.

name: Dinosaur BBQ
dsc: Dinosaur BBQ from Syracuse, New York is famous for its bold, flavorful BBQ, and their Ribs & Chicken Combo Pack is a perfect example. This pack includes two full racks of pork ribs and two whole smoked chickens, all coated in Dinosaur's signature sweet-and-spicy sauce. The ribs are fall-off-the-bone tender, and the chicken is juicy with a crispy, smoky skin. This combo serves 6 to 8 people and is perfect for family dinners, cookouts, or any casual gathering. It also includes a bottle of their famous sauce and detailed reheating instructions. Dinosaur BBQ has been a staple of the Northeast BBQ scene for decades, and this pack allows you to enjoy their legendary flavors at home.

name: Old 300 BBQ
dsc: Old 300 BBQ from Blanco, Texas brings you a Half Texas Smoked Brisket that is packed with flavor. This brisket is made from high-quality Angus beef, rubbed with a simple blend of salt and pepper, and smoked over post-oak wood for 14 hours. The result is a half-brisket that is incredibly tender, with a deep smoky flavor and a beautiful bark. It's perfect for smaller gatherings or for those who want to enjoy premium Texas BBQ without buying a whole brisket. This pack serves 4 to 6 people and includes a bottle of Old 300's signature sauce, which adds a tangy, slightly sweet finish to the meat.

name: Micklethwait Craft Meats
dsc: Micklethwait Craft Meats from Austin, Texas offers an incredible BBQ Meat and Sides Feast that serves up to 15 people. This massive package includes two whole briskets, three racks of ribs, and a large portion of pulled pork, along with generous servings of their famous sides: smoked baked beans, creamy coleslaw, and tangy potato salad. The meats are smoked over post-oak wood and are known for their incredible flavor and tenderness. This feast is perfect for corporate events, large family reunions, or any celebration where you need to feed a crowd. It comes with a variety of house-made sauces and reheating instructions for a stress-free experience.

name: Big Bob Gibson Bar-B-Q
dsc: Big Bob Gibson Bar-B-Q's Choose Your Own World Championship BBQ - 2 Pack allows you to select two of their award-winning meats. Options include pulled pork, sliced turkey, smoked chicken, and brisket. Each meat is smoked over hickory wood and seasoned with their championship-winning rubs. This 2-pack is perfect for couples, small families, or anyone who wants to sample a variety of flavors without overcommitting. It comes with a bottle of their famous white sauce, a tangy Alabama specialty that pairs perfectly with smoked meats. This is a great introduction to one of the most decorated BBQ joints in the country.

name: Kings BBQ
dsc: Kings BBQ's Food Explorer Carolina BBQ Pack is a curated selection of their most beloved offerings. It includes hand-chopped pork BBQ, smoked sausage, and a full rack of ribs, along with a bottle of their signature vinegar-based sauce. This pack allows you to explore the full spectrum of Carolina BBQ flavors, from the tangy and sharp to the sweet and smoky. The pork is smoked over a wood fire and hand-pulled for the perfect texture, while the sausage is seasoned with a secret blend of spices. This serves 4 to 6 people and is ideal for those who want to try a bit of everything. It also includes detailed reheating instructions.

name: Perini Ranch Steakhouse
dsc: Perini Ranch Steakhouse from Buffalo Gap, Texas is known for its mesquite-smoked meats, and their Peppered Beef Tenderloin is a standout. This tenderloin is rubbed with a coarse black pepper and garlic blend, then smoked over mesquite wood for a bold, smoky flavor. The mesquite imparts a distinct, slightly sweet smokiness that pairs perfectly with the rich beef. This tenderloin is incredibly tender and juicy, making it ideal for special occasions, holiday dinners, or any meal that calls for something truly exceptional. It serves 6 to 8 people and comes with detailed reheating instructions. Perini Ranch has been serving top-quality Texas cuisine for decades, and this tenderloin is a perfect example of their expertise.

name: Southside Market & Barbeque
dsc: Southside Market & Barbeque is famous for its creative and delicious sausages, and their Bacon Wrapped Cheddar Jalapeño Sausage Slammers are a fan favorite. These slammers are made from premium pork, blended with sharp cheddar cheese and spicy jalapeños, then wrapped in thick-cut bacon and smoked over post-oak wood. The result is a savory, spicy, and smoky bite that is perfect as an appetizer, snack, or main course. This pack includes 12 slammers and serves 4 to 6 people. It comes with a bottle of their signature sauce for dipping. These slammers are sure to be a hit at any party, tailgate, or casual gathering.

name: The Shed BBQ & Blues Joint
dsc: The Shed BBQ & Blues Joint's larger dinner pack serves 8 people and includes three full racks of ribs and over four pounds of pulled pork. This is the perfect choice for bigger parties, family reunions, or any event where you need to feed a hungry crowd. The ribs are smoked over a blend of hickory and fruitwoods, giving them a sweet and smoky flavor that pairs perfectly with the tangy sauce. The pulled pork is seasoned with a secret spice blend and smoked until it's tender and juicy. This pack includes a bottle of their signature BBQ sauce and reheating instructions for a hassle-free meal.

name: The Shed BBQ & Blues Joint
dsc: The Shed BBQ & Blues Joint's Pit-Smoked BBQ Ham is a delicious alternative to traditional pork or beef BBQ. This ham is smoked over a blend of hickory and fruitwoods, giving it a sweet and smoky flavor that is incredibly addictive. The ham is then glazed with a sticky, tangy BBQ sauce that caramelizes beautifully on the outside while keeping the meat juicy and tender on the inside. This ham serves 6 to 8 people and is perfect for holiday dinners, Sunday suppers, or any meal that calls for a comforting, flavorful centerpiece. It includes a bottle of their signature sauce and reheating instructions.

name: Melissa Cookston's Memphis BBQ
dsc: Melissa Cookston's Memphis BBQ brings you a classic Ribs and Pulled Pork Combo for 4 that is bursting with authentic Tennessee flavor. The ribs are dry-rubbed with a secret blend of spices and smoked over hickory wood, then served with a tangy, tomato-based sauce on the side. The pulled pork is hand-pulled and mixed with a vinegar-based sauce that adds a delightful tang. This combo includes a full rack of ribs and two pounds of pulled pork, along with a bottle of their signature sauce. It's perfect for a family dinner, a small gathering, or anyone who wants to enjoy true Memphis-style BBQ without leaving home.

name: Guy Fieri
dsc: Guy Fieri's BBQ Pulled Pork Trash Can Nachos are a fun and flavorful twist on traditional nachos. This kit includes everything you need to create this iconic dish at home: tortilla chips, pulled pork, BBQ sauce, cheese sauce, and a blend of zesty spices. The pulled pork is smoked and shredded, then piled high on a bed of chips with a generous drizzle of cheese and sauce. It's then baked until the cheese is melted and bubbly, and topped with fresh jalapeños and sour cream. This kit serves 4 to 6 people and is perfect for a game-day snack, a casual dinner, or any fun gathering with friends.

name: Joe's KC BBQ
dsc: Joe's KC BBQ's Z-Man Sandwich is legendary, and now you can make 8 of them at home with this kit. The Z-Man features tender smoked brisket, melted provolone cheese, and crispy onion rings on a soft Kaiser roll, all served with a side of Joe's sweet-and-tangy BBQ sauce. This kit includes 8 Kaiser rolls, 2 pounds of sliced brisket, provolone cheese, onion rings, and a bottle of signature sauce. It's perfect for family dinners, gatherings, or any occasion where you want to impress your guests with one of the most famous BBQ sandwiches in the country. Easy-to-follow assembly instructions are included.

name: Dangerously Delicious Pies
dsc: Dangerously Delicious Pies from Baltimore brings you a unique and savory Pulled Pork BBQ Pie that is sure to become a new favorite. This pie is filled with slow-smoked pulled pork, caramelized onions, and a rich BBQ sauce, all encased in a flaky, buttery crust. The filling is sweet, smoky, and savory, with a texture that is both tender and satisfying. This pie serves 6 to 8 people and is perfect for a potluck, a family meal, or any occasion where you want to serve something different and delicious. It comes with a bottle of their signature BBQ sauce for drizzling over the top.

name: Central BBQ
dsc: Central BBQ's Sauce and Rubs Kit is a must-have for any BBQ enthusiast. This kit allows you to choose three of their most popular sauces and rubs, including their sweet-and-tangy BBQ sauce, spicy vinegar-based sauce, and a dry rub that is perfect for ribs and brisket. Each sauce is made from scratch using high-quality ingredients and Central BBQ's secret recipes. The rubs are a blend of spices that add depth and flavor to any meat. This kit is perfect for those who love to cook and want to replicate Central BBQ's famous flavors at home. It also makes a great gift for any foodie.

name: Meat Mitch
dsc: Meat Mitch from Kansas City offers a KC BBQ Sampler that features all the classics: brisket, burnt ends, pulled pork, and spicy sausage. This sampler is a celebration of Kansas City BBQ, known for its sweet, tangy sauces and slow-smoked meats. The brisket is tender and juicy, the burnt ends are caramelized and smoky, the pulled pork is hand-pulled and flavorful, and the sausage is perfectly spiced. This pack serves 6 to 8 people and includes a bottle of Meat Mitch's signature sauce, which has won multiple awards for its perfect balance of sweet and heat. It's perfect for anyone who wants to experience the best of KC BBQ.

name: Blue Smoke
dsc: Blue Smoke's Backyard BBQ Picnic for 4-6 is the perfect package for a relaxed outdoor meal. It includes a full rack of ribs, a whole smoked chicken, a pound of brisket, and a pound of pulled pork, along with a selection of their famous sides: coleslaw, baked beans, and cornbread. All the meats are smoked over cherry wood, giving them a sweet, fruity flavor that pairs perfectly with the tangy sauces. This picnic pack is ideal for a day at the park, a backyard party, or a family reunion. It includes all the fixings you need for a complete, delicious meal that everyone will enjoy.

name: Kings BBQ
dsc: Kings BBQ's Pig Out Party Pack is a massive feast that serves up to 12 people. It includes two full racks of ribs, five pounds of pulled pork, two pounds of brisket, and a pack of smoked sausages, along with a bottle of their famous Carolina BBQ sauce. This pack is designed for parties, tailgates, and any event where you need to feed a large crowd. The ribs are fall-off-the-bone tender, the pulled pork is juicy and flavorful, and the brisket is perfectly smoked. This is the ultimate BBQ experience for pork lovers, and it comes with detailed reheating instructions to make your party stress-free.

name: Bludso's BBQ
dsc: Bludso's BBQ offers a Smoked Whole Brisket that is unsliced and serves 15 to 20 people. This is the ultimate centerpiece for any large gathering. The brisket is smoked over oak wood for 14 hours, developing a rich, smoky flavor and a beautiful bark. It's left unsliced so you can slice it to your preferred thickness, preserving its juices and ensuring maximum tenderness. This brisket is perfect for weddings, corporate events, or any celebration where you want to serve the best BBQ possible. It comes with a bottle of Bludso's signature sauce and reheating instructions.

name: Underbelly by Chris Shepherd
dsc: Underbelly by Chris Shepherd brings a unique twist to Texas BBQ with their Unconventional Texas BBQ Sampler. This pack includes brisket, pulled pork, smoked sausage, and a special beef cheek, all smoked over post-oak wood and seasoned with a blend of spices that reflect Houston's diverse culinary scene. The brisket is tender and juicy, the pulled pork is smoky and flavorful, and the beef cheek is a melt-in-your-mouth delicacy that is rarely found in traditional BBQ samplers. This serves 4 to 6 people and includes a bottle of Underbelly's house-made sauce. It's perfect for those who want to experience something new and exciting in the world of BBQ.

name: Snow's BBQ
dsc: Snow's BBQ brings you Texas-Sized Pork Spare Ribs that are big on flavor and perfect for any BBQ lover. These ribs are seasoned with a simple salt-and-pepper rub and smoked over post-oak wood for 6 hours, resulting in a tender, smoky, and slightly sweet flavor. The ribs are fall-off-the-bone tender, with a beautiful caramelized crust that adds a satisfying crunch. This pack includes 2 full racks of ribs, serving 4 to 6 people. It comes with a bottle of Snow's signature sauce, which adds a tangy, slightly sweet finish to the ribs. Perfect for a family dinner, a cookout, or any occasion that calls for classic Texas BBQ.

name: Jack Stack BBQ
dsc: Jack Stack BBQ from Kansas City is known for its high-quality meats and gourmet sides. Their Best Sellers BBQ Buffet Pack includes a selection of their most popular items: beef brisket, burnt ends, smoked turkey, and baby back ribs. Each meat is smoked over hickory wood and served with a side of their famous baked beans, coleslaw, and potato salad. This buffet pack serves 8 to 10 people and is perfect for large gatherings, office parties, or any event where you want to offer a variety of BBQ favorites. It also includes a bottle of Jack Stack's signature sauce, which is sweet, tangy, and perfectly balanced.

name: Arthur Bryant's Barbeque
dsc: Arthur Bryant's Barbeque is a Kansas City icon, and their Barbeque Sampler for 12-16 is a massive feast that includes all their signature meats: burnt ends, brisket, pulled pork, smoked turkey, and ribs. Each meat is smoked over hickory wood and sliced to perfection. This assortment is perfect for large family reunions, corporate events, or any celebration where you need to feed a big crowd. It comes with a generous supply of their famous sauce and a variety of sides, including baked beans and coleslaw. This is the ultimate BBQ experience for anyone who loves authentic, old-school barbecue.

name: Ugly Drum
dsc: Ugly Drum from Los Angeles offers a unique take on BBQ with their Half Pit-Smoked Pastrami Brisket. This brisket is cured with a blend of spices, then smoked over a custom wood blend until it's tender and full of flavor. The pastrami brisket has a bold, peppery flavor with a hint of garlic and coriander, making it a delicious alternative to traditional BBQ brisket. This half-brisket weighs 3 pounds and serves 4 to 6 people. It comes with a bottle of Ugly Drum's signature sauce and reheating instructions. Perfect for those who want to try something different and delicious.

name: Kings BBQ
dsc: Kings BBQ's Pork Ribs are a Carolina classic, and this 4-rack pack is perfect for feeding a crowd. The ribs are rubbed with a secret blend of spices and smoked over a wood fire until they are fall-off-the-bone tender. They are then coated in a vinegar-based sauce that adds a tangy, slightly sweet flavor. This pack includes 4 full racks of ribs, serving 8 to 10 people. It comes with a bottle of Kings' signature sauce and reheating instructions. Whether you're hosting a party, a tailgate, or a family dinner, these ribs are sure to be a hit with everyone.

name: Melissa Cookston's Memphis BBQ
dsc: Melissa Cookston's Memphis BBQ offers 2 slabs of their famous ribs, which are a perfect representation of Memphis-style BBQ. The ribs are dry-rubbed with a blend of spices, then smoked over hickory wood for 5 hours, resulting in a tender, flavorful, and slightly smoky meat. They are served with a tomato-based sauce on the side, allowing you to add as much or as little as you like. This 2-slab pack serves 4 to 6 people and is perfect for a family dinner, a small gathering, or anyone who loves authentic Memphis BBQ. It includes reheating instructions to ensure the ribs are as delicious as fresh off the smoker.

name: Terry Black's Barbecue
dsc: Terry Black's Barbecue brings you their Original Texas Smoked Sausage, a true Austin favorite. This sausage is made from a blend of premium beef and pork, seasoned with a secret mixture of spices, and smoked over post-oak wood for 6 hours. The result is a sausage that is juicy, smoky, and full of flavor, with a satisfying snap when you bite into it. This pack includes 4 links of sausage, serving 4 to 6 people. It comes with a bottle of Terry Black's signature sauce, which pairs perfectly with the smoky sausage. Perfect for grilling, slicing, or adding to your favorite BBQ dishes.

name: 4505 Burgers & BBQ
dsc: 4505 Burgers & BBQ from San Francisco offers The Presidential Smoked Meat Sampler, a feast fit for a leader. This sampler includes a whole smoked brisket, a full rack of pork spare ribs, a pack of hot links, and a whole smoked chicken. Each meat is smoked over a blend of woods and seasoned with 4505's signature spice blend. The brisket is tender and juicy, the ribs are fall-off-the-bone, the hot links have a spicy kick, and the chicken is perfectly smoked and moist. This sampler serves 10 to 12 people and is perfect for any large gathering or celebration.

name: Bludso's BBQ
dsc: Bludso's BBQ offers a Smoked Whole Pork Shoulder that is perfect for serving 10 to 15 people. This shoulder is rubbed with a secret blend of spices and smoked over oak wood for 12 hours, resulting in a tender, juicy, and incredibly flavorful meat. The pork shoulder is pulled and mixed with a tangy, vinegar-based sauce that adds a delightful brightness to the rich, smoky flavor. This is the ideal centerpiece for any large gathering, from birthday parties to family reunions. It comes with a bottle of Bludso's signature sauce and reheating instructions to ensure a stress-free meal.

name: Hill Country Barbecue Market
dsc: Hill Country Barbecue Market's Pitmaster BBQ Brisket + Pulled Pork Sandwich Kit for 6-8 is perfect for creating delicious sandwiches at home. This kit includes 2 pounds of sliced brisket, 2 pounds of pulled pork, 8 artisan sandwich rolls, and a bottle of their signature BBQ sauce. The brisket is smoked over post-oak wood, giving it a classic Central Texas flavor, while the pulled pork is smoked over hickory wood for a sweet, smoky taste. This kit is perfect for a casual dinner, a weekend lunch, or any occasion where you want to enjoy delicious BBQ sandwiches without the hassle of cooking.

name: Schmidt Family BBQ
dsc: Schmidt Family BBQ from Bee Cave, Texas offers a customizable BBQ Dinner for 4-6. You can choose from a variety of meats, including brisket, pulled pork, and smoked turkey, and sides like coleslaw, potato salad, and baked beans. Each meat is smoked over post-oak wood and seasoned with a traditional Texas rub. The brisket is tender and juicy, the pulled pork is flavorful, and the turkey is moist and smoky. This dinner is perfect for a family meal, a small gathering, or any occasion where you want to enjoy authentic Texas BBQ. It includes reheating instructions to ensure a perfect meal every time.

name: Goode Co. Barbeque
dsc: Goode Co. Barbeque from Houston is a Texas institution, and their Slow Smoked BBQ Ribs Dinner is a must-try. This dinner includes two full racks of pork ribs that are seasoned with a dry rub and smoked over post-oak wood for 6 hours, then glazed with a tangy, slightly sweet sauce. The ribs are fall-off-the-bone tender, with a beautiful caramelized crust. This dinner serves 4 to 6 people and includes a side of their famous jalapeño cheese sausage, coleslaw, and beans. It comes with a bottle of Goode Co.'s signature sauce and reheating instructions. Perfect for any occasion that calls for great Texas BBQ.

name: 4505 Burgers & BBQ
dsc: 4505 Burgers & BBQ's Junior Smoked Meat Sampler is a scaled-down version of their famous sampler, perfect for smaller gatherings. It includes a half-rack of ribs, a pound of brisket, a pack of hot links, and a half-chicken. Each meat is smoked over a blend of woods and seasoned with 4505's signature spice blend. The ribs are tender and flavorful, the brisket is juicy, the hot links have a spicy kick, and the chicken is perfectly smoked. This sampler serves 4 to 6 people and is perfect for a family dinner, a small party, or anyone who wants to sample a variety of BBQ flavors.

name: Old 300 BBQ
dsc: Old 300 BBQ from Blanco, Texas offers a Texas Smoked Whole Brisket that is a true representation of Central Texas BBQ. This brisket is made from high-quality Angus beef, rubbed with a simple blend of salt and pepper, and smoked over post-oak wood for 14 hours. The result is a whole brisket that is incredibly tender, with a deep smoky flavor and a beautiful bark. This brisket serves 10 to 12 people and comes with a bottle of Old 300's signature sauce, which adds a tangy, slightly sweet finish to the meat. It's perfect for large gatherings, celebrations, or any occasion that calls for premium Texas BBQ.

name: 17th Street BBQ
dsc: 17th Street BBQ is a world-championship-winning BBQ joint from Murphysboro, Illinois, and their Grand World Champion BBQ Baby Back Ribs are legendary. This 4-slab pack includes four full racks of ribs that are dry-rubbed with a secret blend of spices, then smoked over hickory wood for 5 hours. The ribs are served with a tangy, tomato-based sauce on the side, allowing you to add as much or as little as you like. This pack serves 8 to 10 people and is perfect for large gatherings, parties, or any event where you want to serve award-winning BBQ. These ribs have won numerous competitions and are sure to impress even the most discerning BBQ lovers.

name: Kings BBQ
dsc: Kings BBQ's Hand-Chopped Pork BBQ is the cornerstone of their menu and a true Carolina tradition. The pork shoulder is smoked over a wood fire for 12 hours, resulting in a tender, juicy, and incredibly flavorful meat. It is then hand-chopped, not pulled, to preserve the texture and ensure each bite has a perfect balance of smoky, juicy, and slightly crispy bits. The pork is mixed with a vinegar-based sauce that adds a tangy, sharp flavor that cuts through the richness of the meat. This pack includes 2 pounds of hand-chopped pork, serving 4 to 6 people. It comes with a bottle of Kings' signature sauce and reheating instructions. This is the ultimate authentic Carolina BBQ experience.
